name: Enchantment Mods
description: 15 new enchantments that work like vanilla ones. Weapons: six aspects (Frostbite, Venom, Withering, Weakening Touch, Sticking, Target), Strength Surge, Zapping chain lightning, and the mansion-only Life Steal and Strength Amplifier. Tools and weapons: Reach. Armor: Protection Surge, Knockback Protection and Alchemist (longer potions). Plus the Breaking curse. Find the books wherever vanilla enchanted books turn up (structure chests, fishing, librarians), or roll them at the enchanting table. Hold a book and tap an anvil to enchant an item or combine it with another book, vanilla or custom. Commands: /enchmods:enchant and /enchmods:disenchant work with every enchantment, ours and vanilla.

name: Armor & Effects HUD
description: Shows your armor and off-hand item with real item icons (glinting when enchanted) and current durability, plus every potion effect with its icon and time remaining, on the left side of the screen. When you hit a player or mob, the damage it actually took (after armor and effects) floats up above it.
